en: Ekakanipāta, Chapter on Those Who Desire Welfare (Atthakāmavagga)
“He who, when being exhorted by one who desires his welfare and feels compassion for him, does not follow that instruction;”
"By not heeding the words of the pigeon,
he lies there as if fallen into the hands of his enemies.
Thus ends the second Jātaka, the Pigeon Jātaka.
